note: Consult-only. The 1917 Code of Canon Law governs the traditional penitential discipline in force across the 1954/1955/1962 editions (until Paenitemini, 1966). Cann. 1250–1254 fix the days of fast, abstinence, and partial abstinence: abstinence on all Fridays (c.1252 §1); fast and abstinence on Ash Wednesday, the Fridays and Saturdays of Lent, the Ember days, and the vigils of Christmas, Pentecost, the Assumption, and All Saints (c.1252 §2); fast alone on the other weekdays of Lent (c.1252 §3). Cited for the uncopyrightable discipline facts the roman:cic-1917 penitential rules encode; the canons' text is never transcribed.
